   140	  // Codex E3-R7-01 closure: do NOT route byte-counting through TextEncoder. A hostile

   142	  // return { length: 0 }, undercounting the envelope and letting an oversized outcome

   535	  /**
   536	   * classifyOutcome(input, opts) — produces a deep-frozen Outcome envelope.
   537	   *
   538	   * Ordered steps (clock MUST NOT fire before Step 9):

   540	   *   1.  input wrapper descriptor snapshot (closed keys; symbol/accessor/proxy rejected)
   541	   *   2.  experiment frozen + E1 shape validation
   542	   *   3.  appliedChange snapshot + shape
   543	   *   4.  followUp snapshot + shape
   544	   *   5.  observation snapshot + shape
   545	   *   6.  controlVariableObservations snapshot + per-element E1 shape
   546	   *   7.  opts snapshot
   547	   *   8.  identity binding (status=applied, sourceExperimentId match, parentCaseId match)
   548	   *   9.  resolve freshness reference time (clock at most once)

    72	      if (o.observedMagnitude !== null && typeof o.observedMagnitude !== 'number') reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    73	      if (typeof o.comparabilityScore !== 'number' || o.comparabilityScore < 0 || o.comparabilityScore > 1) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_COMPARABILITY_INSUFFICIENT);
    74	      if (!Array.isArray(o.confounders) || o.confounders.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    75	      if (o.driverFeedback !== null && !_nonEmptyStr(o.driverFeedback)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DRIVER_FEEDBACK_INVALID);
    76	      if (!Array.isArray(o.dataQualityIssues) || o.dataQualityIssues.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_DATA_QUALITY_INVALID);
    77	      if (!Array.isArray(o.sideEffects) || o.sideEffects.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    78	      if (!Array.isArray(o.limitations) || o.limitations.length > ARRAY_CAP) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    79	      if (!_nonEmptyStr(o.createdAt)) reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID);
    80	
    81	      // confounders-present → class must be inconclusive_due_to_confounders OR limitations carries CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING.
    82	      if (Array.isArray(o.confounders) && o.confounders.length > 0
    83	          && o['class'] !== 'inconclusive_due_to_confounders'
    84	          && o['class'] !== 'invalid_comparison'
    85	          && !(Array.isArray(o.limitations) && o.limitations.indexOf('CONTROL_VARIABLE_MISSING') !== -1)) {
    86	        reasons.push(CODES.OUTCOME_CONFOUNDERS_PRESENT);
    87	      }
    88	
    89	      if (reasons.length) {
    90	        var seen = Object.create(null), out = [];
    91	        reasons.forEach(function (c) { if (!seen[c]) { seen[c] = true; out.push(c); } });
    92	        return RC.buildBlockedResult(out);
    93	      }
    94	      return Object.freeze({ valid: true });
    95	    } catch (eOuter) {
    96	      return RC.buildBlockedResult([CODES.OUTCOME_INVALID, CODES.INTERNAL_CONTRACT_VIOLATION]);
    97	    }
    98	  }

   103	    SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION: SUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION,
   104	    validateOutcomeShape: validateOutcomeShape,
   105	  };
